title: REMEMBER
focus_line: Hope is the confident expectation in God's promises, anchored in Christ.

verse.text: I will remember the deeds of the Lord; yes, I will remember your miracles of long ago. I will consider all your works and meditate on all your mighty deeds.

session.prompt: Read Psalm 77 and watch the psalmist move from despair to hope by remembering what God has done.
Build a list of the specific things God has done in your life, and use this time to rebuild or strengthen your hope.

coaching_notes: The Lord has a plan for your life. Use today's session to revisit parts of that plan. How amazing it is to see God's redemptive work in your life.
